_comment: Copy to settings.json to use it. Leave values empty for interactive sign-in with Microsoft's default app. Graph ClientId alone (no thumbprint): interactive sign-in with your own app registration. ClientId + CertificateThumbprint: app-only. Certificate auth only - never put client secrets in this file.

Session._comment: Sign-ins also always end at midnight, when the PC sleeps and when the toolkit closes. MaxAgeHours: 1-24, IdleMinutes: 1-1440.
